arms.owalnuts-diag: owalnuts::sampler defaults: Metric::diagonal(), Adaptation::default() (Stan diagonal regularisation, MomentumSum U-turn, no chain rescue)
arms.owalnuts-dense: Metric::dense() + Adaptation::default(), literally as shipped (MeanVarianceShrinkage, DenseWarmupSeeding::Legacy), plus the WP48 admission fix without which it cannot run 1,000 draws
arms.owalnuts-dense-seeded: Metric::dense() + Adaptation::Custom(WarmupConfig::new(0.8) + DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION + DEFAULT_METRIC_REGULARIZATION + DenseWarmupSeeding::PerTransition); shipped shrinkage

funnel.gate: |MCSE z| <= 2 for P(omega < -5) on every seed

auto_rule.statistic: seed-median over the three owalnuts-diag cells of the maximum absolute off-diagonal correlation of the unconstrained draws, first 500 retained draws per chain pooled (stand-in for the last slow window; same metric)
auto_rule.winner: seed-median dense/diag min-bulk-ESS-per-gradient >= 1.5 and dense gate passes >= diag
auto_rule.loser: ratio < 1.0 or dense gate passes < diag
auto_rule.recommend_iff: the predictor selects every winner and no loser, at least one winner exists, and the arm passes D3 (funnel); evaluated separately for each dense arm

decision_rules.D1: For each target model and each dense arm (owalnuts-dense, owalnuts-dense-seeded, owalnuts-dense-stan) separately: advised iff seed-median dense/diag min-bulk-ESS-per-gradient >= 1.5 AND dense gate passes >= diag gate passes (of 3). Verdict per arm: supported if 3/3 targets advised, mixed if 1-2, not supported if 0. Advice for dense-seeded / dense-stan is conditional on adopting the respective opt-ins.
decision_rules.D3: Each dense arm is funnel-harmless iff |MCSE z| <= 2 for P(omega < -5) on every seed; failure blocks an auto recommendation for that arm.

eight_schools-eight_schools_noncentered.basis: no parameter-block reference columns; noncentered posterior nearly independent

eight_schools-eight_schools_centered.basis: funnel; a global linear metric cannot fix it; formula would say 2.6/3.8
eight_schools-eight_schools_centered.class_dense: neutral or loser (0/3 gates every arm)
eight_schools-eight_schools_centered.class_dense_stan: neutral or loser (0/3 gates every arm)

gp_pois_regr-gp_pois_regr.basis: no parameter-block reference columns (f_tilde absent); noncentered GP, alpha/rho-f_tilde coupling is nonlinear

mcycle_gp-accel_gp.basis: formula says 0.69 / 12.3; the sdgp/lscale-to-zgp scale coupling is nonlinear, so dense-stan is tempered to 2.0

predictions.prediction_rule: Formula: sqrt(kappa_diag / (kappa_dense * w)), kappa from the reference-posterior unconstrained covariance with each estimator applied at n = 500 (artifacts/reference-geometry.json), w = ((1 + sqrt(d/n)) / (1 - sqrt(d/n)))^2 the Wishart estimation-noise factor for a dense estimate. A per-model ratio prediction holds if the observed seed-median ratio is within a factor 2 of it.
predictions.P1: geometric-mean ESS/gradient ratio versus diag over the 17 models: owalnuts-dense-stan >= 2.0 (formula about 4); owalnuts-dense-seeded between 0.6 and 1.5 (formula 1.22); owalnuts-dense (literal) <= 0.7
predictions.P2: owalnuts-dense-seeded loses gate passes versus diag on earnings, kidiq and sblrc (scale-dependent floor), and its installed kappa on those three exceeds the diag arm's
predictions.P3: diamonds: diag depth-cap fraction >= 0.05 and step <= 0.006; dense-stan zero depth caps in at least 2 of 3 seeds and median step >= 0.05; dense-seeded median step between diag and dense-stan
predictions.P4: D1: owalnuts-dense (literal) not supported; owalnuts-dense-seeded mixed (diamonds advised only); owalnuts-dense-stan mixed (diamonds and accel_gp advised, gp_pois_regr not)
predictions.P5: D2: no auto rule for any dense arm at c* = 0.6. For dense-stan the predicted false positive is sblrc (max|corr| 0.82; Stan's absolute 1e-3 prior floors its 1e-5 variances); for dense-seeded several (earnings, kidiq, sblrc, accel_gp); for the literal arm most selected models
predictions.P6: funnel: dense-seeded and dense-stan |z| <= 2 on every seed; literal dense reported (no prediction of the sign; its warmup is not ergodic)
predictions.P7: kernel overhead per gradient (dense minus diag, iid Gaussian, quiet minimum): <= 0.5 us at d <= 10 and <= 3 us at d = 66
predictions.P8: CmdStan dense_e: on diamonds >= 20x the v6 CmdStan diag_e ESS/gradient; owalnuts-dense-stan between 0.6x and 1.2x CmdStan dense_e ESS/gradient on each target model where both pass
predictions.per_model_ess_per_gradient_ratio_vs_diag: 'dense' entries in the table are now the dense-seeded predictions (shipped shrinkage, fresh seeds); 'dense_stan' unchanged. The literal owalnuts-dense arm (Legacy seeding) has no formula: predicted ratio < 1.0 on at least 12 of 17 models and gate passes <= diag on every model.
predictions.P9: whitened kappa (median over chains, seed median): dense-stan below diag on every model whose reference kappa_stan_diag_oracle >= 50 except sblrc; literal dense above diag on at least 12 of 17 models

library_changes_before_freeze.admission_fix: sample_chains_dense_with_target_budget_and_control raises each chain's inner max_target_evaluations to the admitted ceiling; before it, Metric::dense() under the default Limits::admit_worst_case() failed every run with >= ~430 retained draws at depth 10 / eight levels ('target-evaluation bound exceeds its resource limit (chain 0)'). Admission only; draws unchanged. Regression test tests/sampler_api.rs::dense_metric_runs_default_length_under_worst_case_admission.
library_changes_before_freeze.DenseWarmupSeeding: opt-in PerTransition; default Legacy reproduces existing runs. Legacy seed splitmix64(seed ^ transition ^ segment_index) is constant over warmup because transition == segment_index.
library_changes_before_freeze.tests: cargo test: all suites pass, kernel_fingerprint unchanged

pre_freeze_smoke_tests: Non-evidence seed 1 only, artifacts not kept: eight_schools_noncentered and arma11 for diag, literal dense and (Legacy-seeded) dense-stan before the seeding fix (literal dense kappa 184 and 170 against diag 2.2 and 1.8; this exposed the seed defect), and eight_schools_noncentered for dense-seeded and dense-stan after it (kappa 2.1 and 2.2). They informed the seeding fix and the decision to add the dense-seeded arm, nothing else.
run_order: models in listed order; arms owalnuts-diag, owalnuts-dense, owalnuts-dense-seeded, owalnuts-dense-stan; seeds ascending; strictly sequential; then CmdStan dense_e on the target models; then the funnel; then the cost decomposition
